verdict.rationale: LegalOS explicitly states that its service pricing excludes government application, biometric and filing fees. It also offers a USCIS fee calculator that estimates filing fees, including Premium Processing and the Asylum Program Fee. Its own fees, however, are only described as "fixed-fee" per-matter proposals with no prices published, so a founder cannot compute an honest all-in cost from the site. Missing for 10: published LegalOS service fees per visa type, a pricing page that itemizes provider fees alongside USCIS and premium processing fees, and independent corroboration of fee transparency.
